# Data Source: catalyst_job_pools

List existing Job Scheduling pools in a Catalyst project. Requires the `ZohoCatalyst.jobpool.READ` OAuth scope and project access. This data source does not create pools or execute jobs. Results are sorted lexicographically by ID; projects without pools return an empty list.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "catalyst_job_pools" "example" {
  project_id = var.project_id
}

output "pools" {
  value = data.catalyst_job_pools.example.pools
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Existing project's positive numeric ID, written as a string.

## Attribute Reference

- `pools` (Attributes List) Existing job pools, sorted by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools))

<a id="nestedatt--pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Job pool ID as a string, preserving precision.
- `name` (String) Job pool name.
- `type` (String) Job pool target type reported by Catalyst, for example Function or Webhook.
